questions.question: In story S24 (E2E helpers, hooks and kept-spec upkeep), is there any vacuous or placeholder production path: a no-op/stub body, a tautological assertion, a frozen stand-in constant, or an optional dependency (injected port, handler, client handle) that silently degrades to non-behavior when not injected? Cite file:line for each injection point in app/tests/e2e/helpers/*.ts; app/tests/e2e/groups-blackout-guard.spec.ts (delete); app/tests/e2e/*.spec.ts (helper-only changes); app/src/lib/testHooks (__fewTest hooks) and show that omitting the dependency fails loudly rather than succeeding silently.

Could `MarmotContext` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist and do they flow through declared seam contracts in architecture.md (imports only via each module's index.ts, no React-context imports under app/src/lib/marmot/**, no ts-mls or @internet-privacy/marmot-ts imports)?

Does S24 comply with the architecture.md boundary rules: only `client/` constructs or disposes the MarmotClient, code inside HistoryBackend calls / inbox handlers / client listeners never awaits an account-scope client call (follow-up work via the owned setTimeout(0) FIFO), group sender identity comes only from orderingKey.account, and idb-keyval update() is not used? List each rule touched by this story's files with file:line evidence, or state why it is not touched.

Do unit, property, and (where the AC names them) library-harness or e2e tests cover the artifacts named in S24's scope (app/tests/e2e/helpers/*.ts; app/tests/e2e/groups-blackout-guard.spec.ts (delete); app/tests/e2e/*.spec.ts (helper-only changes); app/src/lib/testHooks (__fewTest hooks))? Show that tests use real collaborators or test fixtures rather than mocking the helper used at the SUT call site, that idb mocks are seeded out of key order where order matters, and that at least one test fails if the production code is replaced by a no-op.

Does the delivered S24 implementation match the intent of its scope (Update helpers (group-setup.ts etc.), __fewTest hooks and store names so every kept spec keeps its titles/assertions; delete groups-blackout-guard.spec.ts; title-set diff against the pre-run tag; verify abandon/ever-known/poll-after-leave specs.) and respect its exclusions (Rewritten specs (S25, S26))? Identify any capability owned by a later story that was built ahead, or any in-scope capability left unimplemented.

Does S24 follow project conventions (all new UI text in i18n.ts with en and de, no hardcoded user-visible strings, make-driven build/test, idb-keyval update() banned, no edits to app/ during an e2e run, and no leak of profile data to unaddressed audiences)? Cite evidence for each convention the story's files touch.

AC-TEST-1: Only `groups-blackout-guard.spec.ts` and the pending-removal assertions in `groups-admin.spec.ts` MAY be deleted among e2e content. `groups-blackout-guard.spec.ts` MUST NOT exist on the final tree; every other spec file listed in `app/tests/e2e` at the pre-run tag (`pre-marmot-library-adoption`) MUST exist on the final tree except `groups-library-smoke.spec.ts` (temporary, never at the pre-run tag). Checked by diffing file lists against the tag. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.

AC-TEST-4: Every other e2e spec (all not named in AC-TEST-1/2) MUST keep its test titles and assertions; only helpers (`app/tests/e2e/helpers/*`), store names and `__fewTest` hooks MAY change. Verified by diffing test titles per file against the tag: the set of `test(` titles per kept spec MUST be unchanged. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.

AC-LEAVE-6: Last-member abandon and the "ever known survives leave" behaviour MUST be preserved. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [e2e:groups-abandon-last-member, groups-ever-known-survives-leave, groups-poll-after-leave (kept)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.
